To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) external text data can be effectively used to improve the performance of a KBQA system, and 2) the use of external text data is beneficial in all phases of the KBQA pipeline.
Text2KB, our system for question answering over a Knowledge Base (KB), significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KBQA systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of answering questions about entities and relations in a Knowledge Base (KB).
the following problem: Given a question in natural language, how to answer it by using the information in a knowledge base.
the following questions: How do we improve question interpretation and candidate generation for KBQA?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is a novel and effective way to enrich question interpretation and candidate generation and ranking for KBQA.
the proposed system, Text2 KB, improves the state of the art in the field of question answering over knowledge bases by utilizing external text data.

the proposed system is able to improve the performance of a state-of-the art KBQA system by using external text resources, such as web search results, question answering forums, and general text documents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can improve the KBQA system with external text data.
we are trying to improve the question answering performance by leveraging external text data.
the combination of KBs with other sources of text data can be very effective to improve the performance of question answering systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the absence of a large amount of training data, it is possible to improve question answering performance by leveraging external text data, such as web documents and community question answering.
the combination of textual and structured KB resources can improve question answering over KBs, and that the combination is complementary rather than substitutable.
, in addition to the knowledge bases themselves, external text data should be leveraged for question answering over knowledge bases.
